newsitem.title: USA: Duke Catawba 1 nuke near full output - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Duke Catawba 1 nuke near full output - NRC.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba 1 nuclear power unit in Clover, S.C., returned near full output following repairs to a main transformer oil leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was running at 99 percent of capacity, NRC said in its Tuesday daily plant status report. The plant was operating at 48 percent power, according to NRC's Monday report.
The adjoining Catawba unit 2, also rated at 1,129 MW, was producing electricity at 100 percent of capacity, NRC said.
Duke operates both Catawba units, and owns 25 percent of Catawba 1.
Duke officials were not immediately available for comment.
